case_scope: Observed events attributed to Flight; outbound flights only
notes: Case·원천 집합·인코딩 고정; 기존 활동 유지. 사건 수와 일부 경로별 비중은 증가/변화. 12 ACT 조건은 Family별 다른 Gold. 초기 업무상 의미 있는 2개 활동부터 누적 추가; 최종 활동 집합 유지. Aggregated case log does not identify each individual passenger/bag; do not infer individual duration or comparison. Preserve occurrence multiplicity (UNION ALL); no deduplication or tie-breaking. MAX TOTAL JOIN DEPTH describes authored reference SQL, not a proven minimum. Population scope explicitly restricted; join depth is the authored path, not a lower bound on SQL alternatives.
case_key_policy: Canonical flight_id; structured (flight_no, operating_date=date(scheduled_offblock)) accepted after full-scope bijection; no inferred composite strings.
alternative_case_policy: Strict canonical Entity; only approved same-entity key representations normalized.
